verdict.rationale: Proa documents several incremental-adoption paths. You can proxy a single route to Proa while the rest stays on Next.js or Rails, and you can call Proa over FFI from Node, Go, Python, Ruby, or Java to render inside an existing stack. Its islands model hydrates only the interactive parts of a page, and scaffolded starters cover a full Axum application. missing for 10: an explicit guide for embedding a Proa component into part of an existing non-Proa page, a documented migration path from partial to full adoption, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
